_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score rarely moves ±2 in this coil; upside (quiet retail, CVD) and downside (ETF/stablecoin dead, crowded longs) cancel, so stay on Anxiety until a sustained >2% break.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst clear HOLD/Anxiety; narrative silent on forward phase, only describes cross-asset pipes
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, fear ~30-45, ETF and stablecoin flows still dead next session
next_move.invalidated_if: Sustained >2% break that either revives ETF/stablecoin demand (toward Complacency) or liquidates crowded longs (toward Denial)
